carried_note: direct = the frame's own SIFT matches to LiDAR photos; carried = LiDAR points whose 2-D track came through neighbouring video frames (still LiDAR-lifted 3-D points, PnP per frame, no triangulation)

focal_search.cost: mean over frames of the mean over ALL matches of min(reprojection, 6.0 px), each frame re-posed by PnP at that focal

intrinsics_check.note: Huber(2 px) mean of squared inlier reprojection, inlier sets fixed, every frame re-refined by LM per evaluation

position_sigma_m.note: PnP covariance from the inlier residuals: measurement noise only, not LiDAR depth / ARKit pose / alignment bias

smoothness.note: |pose - interpolation of its neighbours (<= 8 source frames each side)|: noise plus real acceleration, so an upper bound on jitter

consistency_rule: dropped when > 0.03 m or > 1.0 deg from the interpolation of its kept neighbours (each <= 8 source frames away)

texture_coverage.metric: median Sobel gradient magnitude of the grey frame at half size (low = plain walls / ceiling)

frame_index_note: benchmark source_index counts frames of the SDR conversion; it has the duplicated frames listed, so the original video's index is source_index minus the duplicates at or before it
